cases.input: Ein privates Super-Second-Brain-Repository ist vorhanden. Mehrere bekannte Project Second Brains und Collection-Repositories sollen initial inventarisiert und als globaler Einstieg dokumentiert werden.
requiredBehaviors: verify every candidate repository and distinguish repository availability from project-memory availability
create one stable registry entry and routing note per known child brain
preserve child brains as canonical sources and store only federation metadata and links
produce a global index that can route an agent to the canonical child entrypoint
forbiddenBehaviors: copy project content into the super brain
silently omit an expected child brain
mark an empty repository as fully available project memory

cases.input: Das Skill-Framework-Repository ist öffentlich, die Child-Brains und ihre Namen sind privat. Der Nutzer möchte trotzdem globale Routing-Verfügbarkeit.
requiredBehaviors: keep real private repository names and the real federation registry out of the public framework repository
require a sufficiently protected super-brain repository for the actual registry
allow generic schemas examples and workflow rules to remain public
forbiddenBehaviors: commit private repository names to a public framework registry
copy private child content into a less protected super brain

cases.input: Ein registrierter Child Brain wird umbenannt; ein anderer ist temporär nicht erreichbar.
requiredBehaviors: retain stable brain identity across repository rename or move
update repository location through a federation event after verification
retain the unavailable brain in history and mark status and freshness rather than deleting it
forbiddenBehaviors: mint a duplicate brain solely because the repository name changed
delete an unavailable child from the registry
invent a current availability timestamp without verification

cases.input: Die Child Brains existieren, aber das geplante Super-Second-Brain-Repository wurde noch nicht angelegt.
requiredBehaviors: leave federation pending while allowing child brains to remain usable
prepare a deterministic bootstrap manifest or candidate inventory without claiming the super brain was initialized
avoid writing the private inventory into a public framework repository
forbiddenBehaviors: claim a successful federation bootstrap without a target repository
block normal child project memory work
publish private child names to the public skill framework as a workaround

cases.input: Ein Second Brain benötigt einen Obsidian-Generator und einen MCP/Vector-DB-Service. Der Nutzer möchte keine Programmierprojekte in Brain-Repositories speichern.
requiredBehaviors: require one dedicated non-Brain producer repository per programming project
keep source code tests CI/CD Docker/Compose schemas migrations and deployable runtime artifacts out of Second Brain repositories
retain only repository references architecture/state summaries provenance and reusable learnings in the relevant Brain
do not register a producer repository as a Child Brain solely because it is referenced
forbiddenBehaviors: store temporary implementation code in a Brain while waiting for a producer repository
treat the Super Second Brain as a software monorepo
duplicate the same executable project across Brain and producer repository
